answers.sql: SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 AS yield FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume';

SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 AS yield FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume';

SELECT ((SELECT r.amount / o.amount FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume') - (SELECT r.amount / o.amount FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume')) * 10000 AS yield_change_bps;

SELECT ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category = 'Transaction revenues') - (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category = 'Transaction revenues')) / ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category LIKE 'Total net revenues%') - (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category LIKE 'Total net revenues%')) * 100 AS tx_contribution;
